items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I’m an entertainment director of the New York Yankees also. And I’ve been with Mr. Steinbrenner for a lot of years.

ctx.x: Oh you were looking out to where you used to sit in the audience.

Where I used to sit, yeah. I know where I used to sit. I wanted to look over the band, so I could see what everybody’s doing. And then when we played it, you know, when I got to do it the first time, it was like — I know a lot of baseball players. I’m an entertainment director of the New York Yankees also. And I’ve been with Mr. Steinbrenner for a lot of years. And I ask ball players, I ask like certain guys, I say, “how did you feel when you — your first major league game, you went to the major leagues? How did…
